env.title: Our Environmental Commitment
env.desc: Understanding plastic hazards and making better choices for the planet
env1.title: The Severity of Plastic Pollution
env1.desc: Around 78 million tonnes of plastic packaging are produced globally each year, and about 32% is released into the environment. An estimated 25 million tonnes end up in the ocean. Conventional plastics take centuries to decompose.
env2.title: Advantages of Biodegradable Materials
env2.desc: Under proper composting conditions, biodegradable materials fully decompose and return to nature without releasing plastic microparticles. Made from natural plant fibers, they support a circular economy.
env3.title: Biodegradable Claims: Know the Difference
env3.desc: Many products labeled 'biodegradable' are actually conventional plastics mixed with other substances that only break down into microparticles and fail international compostability certification. Mao Mao Feng Lin's materials are genuinely biodegradable/compostable resins.
env4.title: Circular Economy and the Future
env4.desc: Global bio-resin production capacity continues to grow, reflecting rising demand for eco-friendly materials. Choosing biodegradable materials is a commitment to a better environment for the next generation.

cert.title: International Certifications
cert.desc: Mao Mao Feng Lin International's products are tested and certified by internationally recognized organizations
cert1.title: SGS Testing & Certification
cert1.desc: SGS is a global leader in inspection, testing, and certification with more than 2,600 offices worldwide. Mao Mao Feng Lin's products pass rigorous SGS testing to ensure product quality meets international standards.
cert2.title: Intertek Certification
cert2.desc: Intertek is a leading global provider of quality assurance services including testing, inspection, and certification. Mao Mao Feng Lin's products pass Intertek verification, ensuring safety and environmental performance.
cert3.title: Beta Bio-Based Content Testing
cert3.desc: Beta Analytic is a leading US laboratory providing radiocarbon dating and bio-based content testing. It verifies bio-based content to ensure the material is genuinely biodegradable.
marketNote: Our products comply with the international compostability standard EN 13432 and can provide documentation for compliance with the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) and national packaging regulations.
compare.title: Genuinely Biodegradable vs. False Claims
compare.sub: Many products labeled 'biodegradable' do not actually decompose
compare.fake1: Conventional plastic + photosensitizers → breaks into fragments
compare.fake2: Conventional plastic + corn starch/calcium carbonate → breaks into microparticles
compare.fake3: Conventional plastic + oxo additives → breaks into powder
compare.fake5: Still releases plastic microparticles into the environment
compare.fake6: Oxo-degradable plastics are banned in the EU
compare.real1: Made from 100% plant fiber composite materials
compare.real3: Fully decomposes and returns to nature
compare.real6: Verified by Beta bio-based content testing
detail.title: Certification Details
detail.sub: Understand the testing standards and meaning behind each certification
detail1.title: SGS Testing Scope
detail1.desc: SGS conducts comprehensive quality and safety testing, including material composition analysis, heavy metal testing, and microbiological testing, ensuring products meet international safety standards and are harmless to people and the environment.
detail2.title: Intertek Verification Standards
detail2.desc: Intertek provides comprehensive quality assurance, verifying that materials meet international standards for biodegradability, heavy metal content, and food contact safety, ensuring products are safe and reliable from raw materials to finished goods.
detail3.title: Beta Bio-Based Content Testing
detail3.desc: Using the ASTM D6866 standard method, bio-based content is measured through radiocarbon dating. High bio-based content indicates the product comes from natural plant materials rather than petroleum-based plastics, making it a truly eco-friendly material.
cta.title: Choose with Confidence, Backed by Evidence
cta.desc: All materials in the Mao Mao Feng Lin International products distributed by Chanting Green Engineering comply with international compostability standards and are backed by complete test reports. Contact us for certification documents and let the data speak for itself.
